summary: Promoted J-18: every screen run leaves an append-only record of what it attempted, and a re-run under identical pins says so before it walks (measured 2026-07-31 from the frozen artifacts, backend down so nothing live was invented: .data/screen holds 11 snapshots carrying no start time, duration, attempted count or terminal state, while the two lesser desk computes each keep a durable ledger - topup-2026-07-29-5de907c83fc4 at 4m23.6s over 404 pairs and two reconcile records at 5.5s/10.8s; DeskScreenComputeManager state is process-scoped and lost on restart, so every failed/cancelled/reused screen run left nothing anywhere; and /desk's Run Screen always submits today's UTC date while trigger 'ALWAYS runs the full member walk rather than pre-checking the store before paying for it', so a duplicate click recomputes 101 tradable maps cold before ScreenStore.record refuses the duplicate - the pre-check needs no new machinery, compute_bar_store_signature and find_by_key already exist and find_by_key is already called one line after the walk). Vision-gap scan: every Vision paragraph and Key Capability claim is covered by an existing journey EXCEPT Vision para 2's 'A coverage view says, per member, which timeframes have bars and how fresh they are' - GET /research/desk/coverage has no live /desk surface (the page renders only each snapshot's frozen per-row coverage copy); it stays uncovered and backlogged as desk-live-coverage-view-on-page (0.31), not promoted, because all 101 members' coverage is already on the page one screen-run stale, so the delta is live-vs-frozen only. No pnl-scan.json exists and this era's Non-Goals forbid strategy/profile/champion work, so no data-pattern candidate was proposable: both proposals are surface work, tagged speculative, never presented as hold-out survivors. The prior backlog item desk-screen-run-ledger-and-member-failure-isolation is superseded on its ledger half and its per-member-isolation half is deliberately NOT proposed - store errors are 0, BarStore collects corrupt files instead of raising, and an error skip row would make an append-only snapshot's content depend on a transient failure, breaking J-03's identical-pins-identical-rows rail.
